GlobalVariables.StudyDescription: This file contains the metadata, events, and data for REDCap project "TBCARE 2026 (MEPI teaching project)".
GlobalVariables.redcap:ProjectNotes: Fictional TB cohort for the MEPI Research Data Management course, University of Antwerp, 2026-27. Two arms (drug-susceptible and drug-resistant TB), two sites (Data Access Groups). Use only simulated data.

redcap:Surveys.title: TBCARE e-Consent
redcap:Surveys.instructions:
Welcome to TBCARE.

This form asks for your consent to take part. Please read the information sheet first. A study nurse is with you if you have questions.
redcap:Surveys.acknowledgement:
Thank you, [cons_name].

Your answers have been saved. The study nurse will give you a copy of this form.

redcap:Surveys.title: TBCARE Quality of life
redcap:Surveys.instructions:
Dear [first-event-name][first_name],

These questions are about how you felt during the last week. This is the [event-label] questionnaire. It takes about 3 minutes.
redcap:Surveys.acknowledgement:
Thank you, [first-event-name][first_name].

Please give the tablet back to the study nurse.
